title: Impact of a Community-Based Primary Health Care Project on the Inappropriate Use of Emergency Medical System in Bergamo
official: Impact of a Community-Based Primary Health Care Project on the Inappropriate Use of Emergency Medical System in Bergamo
summary: The goal of this study is to reduce the inappropriate use of the Emergency Medical System in Bergamo. The main question it aims to answer is: can a Community-Based Primary Health Care Project impact on the use of the Emergency Medical System in Bergamo? Monthly changes in urgent calls to the Emergency Medical System will be analysed.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Urgent Emergency Medical System call

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non-urgent Emergency Medical System call
